# Blue Lock Manga — bluelockchapter.com

## About
Blue Lock Manga (https://www.bluelockchapter.com/) is a dedicated digital reading platform for the sports manga series "Blue Lock" (ブルーロック) written by Muneyuki Kaneshiro and illustrated by Yusuke Nomura. The site provides instant, high-definition English scan translations of all serialized chapters, character guides, arc breakdowns, and release schedules.

## Manga Metadata
- Official Title: Blue Lock
- Japanese Title: ブルーロック (Buruu Rokku)
- Author: Muneyuki Kaneshiro (Story)
- Artist: Yusuke Nomura (Art)
- Publisher: Kodansha
- Serialization: Weekly Shōnen Magazine
- Serialization Debut: August 1, 2018
- Status: Ongoing
- Volumes in Japan: 40 (as of August 2026)
- Genres: Sports, Psychological Drama, Shounen, Action, Soccer
- Synopsis: Following a crushing round-of-16 exit at the 2018 FIFA World Cup, the Japan Football Union hires eccentric coach Jinpachi Ego. Ego conceives the "Blue Lock" project — an extreme, prison-like boarding school gathering 300 elite high school forwards from across Japan. Through cutthroat, survival-of-the-fittest selection rounds, 299 strikers will be eliminated forever, leaving only one revolutionary egoist capable of leading Japan to World Cup glory.

## Story Arcs
1. First Selection Arc (Chapters 1–38): Team Z's round-robin matches. https://www.bluelockchapter.com/arcs/first-selection
2. Second Selection Arc (Chapters 39–87): squad-stealing duels; Isagi, Nagi and Barou vs Rin. https://www.bluelockchapter.com/arcs/second-selection
3. Third Selection & Japan U-20 Match (Chapters 88–151): World Five, then Blue Lock Eleven vs Japan U-20. https://www.bluelockchapter.com/arcs/third-selection-u20
4. Neo Egoist League Arc (Chapters 152–302): five European clubs, transfer valuations. https://www.bluelockchapter.com/arcs/neo-egoist-league
5. U-20 World Cup Arc (Chapter 303 onward, ongoing): Blue Lock Japan at the FIFA U-20 World Cup. https://www.bluelockchapter.com/arcs/u20-world-cup

## Anime
- Season 1: 24 episodes (Oct 2022 – Mar 2023). Season 2 (vs. U-20 Japan): 14 episodes (Oct – Dec 2024). Movie: Blue Lock: Episode Nagi (April 19, 2024). Season 3 (Neo Egoist League): in production, no release date as of November 2026. Studio: Eight Bit.
- Guide: https://www.bluelockchapter.com/anime

## Core Characters & Weapons
- Yoichi Isagi (Protagonist): Spatial Awareness, Direct Shoot, Metavision, Egocentrism.
- Meguru Bachira: Egoist Dribbling, Monster Intuition, Breakdance Footwork, Key Passing.
- Rin Itoshi: Absolute Kick Precision, Puppeteer Strategy, Metavision, Destructive Instinct.
- Rensuke Kunigami: Knuckle Shot, Left-Foot Long-Range Cannon, Wild Card Physical Power.
- Hyoma Chigiri: Top-End Sprint Speed, 44-Caliber Golden Zone Curler, Mach-Speed Breakaway.
- Seishiro Nagi: Supernatural First-Touch Trapping, Five-Stage Revolver Volley, Juggling Shot.
- Shoei Barou: The Pitch Monarch, Predator Eye, 29-Meter Sharp Curve Shot, Chopping Feints.
- Reo Mikage: Chameleon Technique (99% dexterity copying of any move), Playmaker Vision.
- Sae Itoshi: New Generation World 11 Midfielder, Passive Metavision, Surgical Passing.
- Michael Kaiser: Bastard München Ace, New Generation World 11, Kaiser Impact Volley.
- Jinpachi Ego: Radical Architect and Head Coach of the Blue Lock project.
